description: Step 2. Verifies domain ownership (DNS TXT / meta tag / .well-known must carry the token from readiness_get_verification_token), then queues a Playwright probe that tries to sign up, accept the terms and mint an API key with no human. Returns the scan id and the public results URL. Fails with DOMAIN_NOT_VERIFIED (with instructions) or RATE_LIMITED (3 scans per host per day). Never solves CAPTCHAs.

url.description: Public https URL of the SaaS signup (or landing) page, e.g. https://example.com/signup

name: readiness_request_scan
